description:
If you like detail, my videos are for you.  I try to cover everything you would need to know to tackle all kinds of home improvement projects. I'm in the process of renovating my 150 yr old home and have been filming each step.  I also build custom homes for a living and have started the process of making tutorial videos for just about every part of the building process.  

Please consider joining my Patreon network.  I just started it, but I think it can be a great resource for anyone taking on projects around the home.  You'll have direct contact with me and will also be able to take advantage of my access to my very talented subcontractors who are some of the best in their trades.  That being said, you do not have to join and I will always do my best to answer any questions you leave in the comments.  I really do enjoy sharing everything I know about building and remodeling homes!

Patreon Link:

www.patreon.com/sgtdonovan
